---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or a new widget
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

**Is your idea related to a problem?**
A clear and concise description of the problem, for example "I always have to ... when ...".

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What should the program or widget do? For a new widget: what does it show, where does the data come from, and what would you configure?

**Alternatives you've considered**
Other solutions or workarounds you thought about.

**Would you like to build it yourself?**
We welcome contributions: see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/imoliamedia/Imolia-Desktop-Customization-Tool/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [Widget Development Guide](https://github.com/imoliamedia/Imolia-Desktop-Customization-Tool/blob/main/docs/WIDGET_DEVELOPMENT.md).

**Additional context**
Screenshots, links, or anything else that helps.
